description: Preventive technical review of electrical projects in Chile with local RIC references.

interface.longDescription:
Sirius Risk Engine is a preventive technical auditor for electrical projects in Chile. It helps engineers, designers and contractors review plans, single-line diagrams, switchboards, load schedules, calculation reports, documents and photographs available in the ChatGPT context. It also covers electric-vehicle charging projects and industrial installations within its documented scope.

Sirius uses a versioned local Chilean RIC reference base, applicable EV documentation and checklists to identify technical findings, inconsistencies and pending verifications, with document and section traceability. It separates observed facts from inferences and confirmed findings. Original documents provide selective support for figures, tables and context. Normal analysis does not require external normative websites.

An active Sirius license and account connection are required. Visual analysis and downloadable PDF reports depend on the capabilities available in the current ChatGPT environment. Sirius supports professional preventive review; it does not sign or certify projects, guarantee SEC approval or replace the responsible professional.
defaultPrompt: ⚡ Revisa este diagrama unifilar conforme al RIC e identifica errores, posibles incumplimientos e inconsistencias técnicas.
⚡ Audita este cuadro de cargas y verifica protecciones, demanda, dimensionamiento y cumplimiento del RIC.
⚡ Revisa esta memoria descriptiva eléctrica conforme al RIC e identifica omisiones, inconsistencias y requisitos faltantes.

publication.release_notes: Production access control and local hybrid normative references.

es-CL.subtitle: Revisión eléctrica preventiva
es-CL.description:
Sirius Risk Engine es un auditor técnico preventivo de proyectos eléctricos en Chile. Apoya a ingenieros, proyectistas y contratistas en la revisión de planos, diagramas unifilares, tableros, cuadros de carga, memorias de cálculo, documentos y fotografías disponibles en el contexto de ChatGPT. Incluye proyectos de electromovilidad e instalaciones industriales dentro de su alcance documentado.

Utiliza una base normativa RIC local versionada, documentación EV y checklists aplicables para identificar hallazgos, inconsistencias y verificaciones pendientes, con trazabilidad por documento y punto. Separa hechos observados, inferencias y hallazgos confirmados. Consulta originales de forma selectiva para figuras, tablas y contexto, sin dependencia de sitios normativos externos.

Requiere licencia Sirius activa y conexión de cuenta. El análisis visual y los informes PDF descargables dependen de las capacidades disponibles en el entorno de ChatGPT. No firma ni certifica proyectos, no garantiza aprobación SEC y no reemplaza al profesional responsable.

positive.description: RIC 11: outlet location relative to a sink. Run the English prompt after normal authentication and the initial welcome, in an established Sirius conversation. No attachments required.
positive.prompt: Check whether a power outlet installed 45 cm horizontally from the outer edge of a sink complies with Chilean electrical regulations. Use RIC 11 only.
positive.expected_behavior: Respond entirely in English. RIC 11 6.4.1.3: lavamanos, 0.30 m; 45 cm outside that horizontal limit. Assess Volume 3 under 6.4.1.4 and conditions of 6.4.3, without substituting shower/bath 0.60 m. No unconditional compliance without protection/vertical-position evidence. RIC 11 only.

positive.description:
RIC 10: specific equipment-location prohibition. Run the English prompt after normal authentication and the initial welcome, in an established Sirius conversation. No attachments required.

Additional language subtest (Spanish), run separately using exactly this prompt:
¿Puede instalarse un tablero eléctrico dentro de un baño según el RIC?
positive.prompt: Check whether an electrical panel installed inside a bathroom complies with Chilean electrical regulations.
positive.expected_behavior:
Respond entirely in English. RIC 10 5.1.3.2 resolves the stated installation: prohibited. Do not ask sanitary-fixture distances before the main conclusion.

For the Spanish subtest: RIC 10 5.1.3.2; no permitido. Explicación íntegramente en español.

positive.description:
RIC 10: required residual-current protection. Run the English prompt after normal authentication and the initial welcome, in an established Sirius conversation. No attachments required.

Additional language subtest (Portuguese), run separately using exactly this prompt:
Um circuito de tomadas sem proteção diferencial de 30 mA está em conformidade com a regulamentação elétrica chilena?
positive.prompt: Check whether a residential outlet circuit without 30 mA residual-current protection complies with Chilean electrical regulations.
positive.expected_behavior:
Respond entirely in English. RIC 10 5.1.3.5 requires residual-current protection with sensitivity no greater than 30 mA; absence of that required protection does not comply. Do not confuse rated current and sensitivity.

For the Portuguese subtest: RIC 10 5.1.3.5; proteção diferencial com sensibilidade não superior a 30 mA; ausência da proteção exigida não está em conformidade. Resposta em português.

positive.description: RIC 01: breaking capacity of a low-voltage service connection. Run the English prompt after normal authentication and the initial welcome, in an established Sirius conversation. No attachments required.
positive.prompt: Check whether a 6 kA circuit breaker used as part of a low-voltage service connection can comply when the prospective short-circuit current at that point is 7 kA. Use RIC 01 only.
positive.expected_behavior: Respond entirely in English. RIC 01 8.2, service connection scope: 1.2 times 7 kA = 8.4 kA; 6 kA is insufficient. Do not introduce other RIC documents.

positive.description: RIC 04: outlet-circuit minimum conductor section. Run the English prompt after normal authentication and the initial welcome, in an established Sirius conversation. No attachments required.
positive.prompt: Check whether a 1.5 mm² copper conductor can be used for a residential outlet circuit under Chilean electrical regulations.
positive.expected_behavior: Respond entirely in English. RIC 04 5.4: outlets minimum 2.5 mm², lighting minimum 1.5 mm²; stated outlet conductor does not comply.
